content:
maria: Heads up — I'm in Porto Mon 3/30 for a meetup. Any quick lunch recs near Ribeira or Casa da Música? Casual, €<15 ideal. Vegetarian-friendly preferred.
kevin: If you can get to Baixa, try "Taberna dos Petiscos" — great sandwiches and salads. 10–12€.
olivia: +1 for Taberna. Also "Casa da Horta" for solid veggie options. Small, cozy.
sam: Francesinha is a Porto must if you're feeling adventurous :hocho: — "Café Santiago" is the classic.
ciara: Warning — francesinha is heavy. If you want lighter: "Zenith Brunch & Cocktails" has good bowls and fast service near Ribeira.
katie: If you want quick, cheap and excellent: pasteis de nata and a bifana from the market stalls. Walkable and under €6. Highly portable.
maria: Love it, thanks! Any addresses or maps?
kevin: "Café Santiago" address: Rua de Passos Manuel 226. Google: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ppSantiagoFakeLink
olivia: "Casa da Horta" — Rua de Bonjardim 457. Vegan mains ~€8.
ciara: If you're by Casa da Música, try the food court at the mall — quick and lots of options.
sam: Quick menu snippet from Café Santiago (copy paste):
```
Francesinha — steak + ham + sausage, covered in cheese, 1 beer included — €11.50
Vegetarian Francesinha (seasonal) — €10.00
```
maria: For the meetup group lunch we might do a short walk. Who's up for francesinha Friday? React with :thumbsup: if yes, :seedling: if you want a veggie spot, :shrug: if not available.
bench-bot: Poll recorded: reactions will be tallied at 15:00 GMT.
kevin: :thumbsup:
olivia: :seedling:
katie: :thumbsup: (but can vouch for pasteis route for quick eats)
maria: Awesome — I'll pick a spot and DM details. Thanks all :heart:
